subject.title: chore(deps-dev): bump the development-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should this dependency batch proceed with the Socket obfuscated-code alerts for `@emnapi/runtime` via `vite` and direct `@react-email/ui`, or should those updates be split/dropped?
rationale: Automation can add the missing formatting, but it cannot decide whether the newly flagged dependency code is acceptable for ClawHub's build and CI supply chain.

options.title: Triage alerts, then repair batch
options.body: Review the Socket alerts and keep the batch only if the dependency risk is accepted and the formatter output is committed.

options.title: Split flagged updates
options.body: Remove or split the Vite/react-email updates so lower-risk dev dependency bumps can proceed separately.

options.title: Close for regeneration
options.body: Close this batch if the flagged supply-chain change is not worth manual triage right now.

recommendation.title: Triage alerts, then repair batch
recommendation.body: Review the Socket alerts and keep the batch only if the dependency risk is accepted and the formatter output is committed.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen owns the recent dependency, Dependabot, and CI gate context most directly connected to the decision.
